notes: Physical vineyard identities for the four Vosne/Flagey Grand Cru AOCs that were absent from the historical named-site seed. The four Grand Cru monopoles (Romanée-Conti, La Romanée, La Tâche and La Grande Rue) already have stable NamedSite identities in named_sites_seed.json and are intentionally not duplicated here. Current ownership and area evidence for those monopoles is stored separately in vineyard_ownership_vosne_grand_crus.json.

bourgogne_vosne_grands_crus.scope: BIVB lists the six Vosne-Romanée Grand Crus and the two neighboring Flagey-Echezeaux Grand Crus.
